purpose: Diagnose MCP bridge conflicts (Path 1 Official Blender Lab MCP 5.1+ vs Path 2 mcp-for-blender, port 9876 collisions, host mismatch) and hand off to runtime-readiness.
triggers: smoke test passed yesterday but recipe fails today
Lab MCP and ahujasid both installed
Claude Desktop and Cursor both pointing at Blender

exclusions.condition: no readiness signal yet (run runtime-readiness first)
no runtime path has been chosen yet
the user wants to switch or set up a path from scratch
the bridge matrix is clean and only one path is active, but smoke tests still fail
the user explicitly wants both paths configured for separate Blender instances on different ports (requires explicit port isolation)

required.name: target_blender_instance
required.description: Running Blender session identifier or binary path experiencing bridge or port collisions

required.name: configured_mcp_hosts_and_addons
required.description: Inventory of enabled Blender add-ons (Lab MCP vs mcp-for-blender) and active MCP client connections

optional.name: port_9876_diagnostics
optional.description: Optional socket/port binding diagnostics around default port 9876

handoffs.label: If the bridge matrix is clean but failures persist
If the user wants to change paths or set up a path
If the intended runtime path has not been chosen yet
